## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting change. Link the task or experiment issue.

## Verification

State what was checked and what remains unverified.

## Research impact

For analytical changes, document any effect on data partitions, preprocessing, seeds, configurations, metrics, or reproducibility. For documentation-only changes, state that no experiment was run.

## Artifacts

Link external datasets, checkpoints, or run records when relevant. Keep credentials and large artifacts out of the repository.
